alternatives.reason: Two independently authored artifacts can drift and re-interpret the requirement; the roadmap requires one decision_id, version and source hash shared by both.
Constitution IV: AI output is candidate evidence; only an identified human accepts a decision.
Grounded advisor candidates over the registry facts cover the P0 decision path; embeddings are a later slice.

architecture_impact: Adds internal/change: a per-Project change ledger (JSON, atomic writes) with immutable Change versions, DecisionRecords and one Work Order per accepted decision.

Deterministic readiness evaluation: missing objective, acceptance criteria, allowed paths, target environment, data_classification or expected_monthly_volume → NEEDS_INPUT with field, owner role and reason; a retired, DRAFT or production target is blocking; nothing missing is invented.

Advisor interface: RuleAdvisor (default, deterministic) and a GeminiAdvisor REST adapter (enabled by GEMINI_API_KEY, falls back to rules on any error); both only produce candidates a human must select.

Accept creates a DecisionRecord bound to source_snapshot_hash (documents + context + repository + topology version/config hash + policy). Brief and Agent Context Pack are pure renderings of that record and carry the same Lineage block; a Work Order is compiled from it with a sha256 work_order_hash.

Staleness is computed on read: newer change version, material topology change after the bound version, retired target, or source snapshot drift make the decision, brief, pack and work order STALE and block Work Order issuance.
HTTP: /v1/projects/{id}/changes (GET/POST), /{change} GET, /{change}/inputs, /{change}/decision, /{change}/work-order. The React workspace adds a Changes panel with the dual view.
cost_assumptions: No cloud resources; Gemini calls only when GEMINI_API_KEY is set (per-call token cost, not measured yet).
unknowns: GeminiAdvisor is UNVERIFIED: no key and no egress to generativelanguage.googleapis.com in the verification workspace.
Durable persistence: same instance-local /tmp caveat as DR-005.
Required business constraints are a fixed policy list (data_classification, expected_monthly_volume); per-Project policy is a later decision.
Cost is reported as UNKNOWN drivers only; the deterministic calculator with versioned prices is not in this slice.
acceptance_criteria: UI-06: a complete Change reaches DECISION_READY and shows candidates, unknowns and the next transition.
UI-07: an incomplete Change is NEEDS_INPUT with field, owner and reason; accepting it is refused; no Work Order can be created.
UI-08: supplying inputs creates a new Change version, re-evaluates, keeps earlier versions readable, and stales any earlier decision.
UI-09: an accepted decision compiles a Work Order with a hash and the same lineage as the pack.
Brief and Agent Context Pack share decision_id, version, source_snapshot_hash, topology_version and policy_version.
Material topology change after acceptance makes decision, pack and work order STALE and blocks issuance.
Consumer fixture trees byte-identical after the full browser journey.
